questions: What is your single biggest frustration with current tools or methods you use in this space?
If Syncscribe could solve that problem reliably, what would make you hesitate to switch?
What pricing structure or monthly amount would you consider fair for this solution?

answers.question: What is your single biggest frustration with current tools or methods you use in this space?
answers.answer: Right now, my default routine revolves around Canvas LMS, Zoom, and Google Classroom. Switching to Syncscribe would require a noticeable improvement in convenience, because changing habits is friction-heavy. It would have to make communicating with Working professionals, students and all demographics radically smoother before I'd make the jump.

answers.question: What pricing structure or monthly amount would you consider fair for this solution?
answers.answer: When it comes to my wallet, I'm pretty straightforward: Cautious and ROI-focused: Willing to pay $30–$90/month if it measurably boosts cohort completion rates and saves grading time. A fair free tier or a very low, transparent cost is the only way I'd consider it.
